title: Sports Day at School
description: Minh and his friends have a busy and fun Sports Day.
instructions: Read about Sports Day. Then choose the right answer.

paragraphs.text: 🏃 Last Friday was Sports Day at Minh's school. The weather was hot and sunny. All the children wore white T-shirts.
The first race was the running race. Minh ran very fast, but his friend Sam was faster. Minh came second.
Next, there was a jumping competition. Lucy jumped the highest in her class. She won a gold medal.
After that, the teachers had a tug-of-war. Mr Brown's team pulled very hard, but Miss Hoa's team won. Everybody laughed and clapped.
🥤 At eleven o'clock, the children had a drink and some orange slices. They sat under the trees because it was very hot.
At the end, the head teacher gave prizes to the winners. Minh got a blue ribbon. He was happy because he did his best.
